text: “You always told me I should have to come to it sooner or later!” she said with a faint smile. “And you have come to it now?” “I shall have to come to it—presently. But there is something else I must come to first.” She paused again, trying to transmit to her voice the steadiness of her recovered smile. “There is some one I must say goodbye to. Oh, not YOU—we are sure to see each other again—but the Lily Bart you knew.
